system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue

See also: Poisons, Hazards

Quongoosh Essence is a dangerous Poison that causes paralysis and blindness in its victim.

Quongoosh Essence Statistics (CL 3)

Keywords: Ingested, Poison

Trigger: A creature ingests Quongoosh Essence.

Attack: +5 vs Fortitude Defense

Recurrence: Each round at the start of the target's turn, until the Quongoosh Essence is treated.

Suggested Skills: The following are suggested Skills for this Hazard:

  • Treat Injury (DC 15; Requires Medical Kit): The character treats the Quongoosh Essence.

Special: A target moved to the "Helpless" step on the Condition Track by Quongoosh Essence becomes Blinded but not unconscious or otherwise helpless as a result of this Poison.
system.source: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
